title: A C++ reader given a cwd-relative data path finds nothing in the sandbox cwd: Tavotto draws zero figures, native draws one
affected_script_shapes: a script that reads data next to itself through a cwd-relative path handed to a C++ reader (pyarrow.parquet.read_table('x.parquet'), pandas.read_parquet and the like) and then plots it
root_cause: The script is run in a sandbox cwd, and the read-only fallback only covers the four open entry points (open / io.open / Path.open / os.open), not C++ readers, glob or exists (ADR 0047 / 0084). The reader cannot see the file next to the script, the script dies with script_error and Tavotto has zero figures while `python script.py` in the script directory draws one (issue #1253). The behavior is kept on purpose; the root cure is the project-level 'run in the script directory' switch. What was fixed is the diagnosis: #1297 makes missing_input_of accept only what the message names as missing and routes enoent to native_miss, and #1299 attaches workdir_hint ('run in the script directory') to the error.

verified.route: Safe engine path via the product discovery chain, sandbox cwd

unverified: a real user session through the UI (the workdir_hint is covered at the engine / HTTP-body level, not clicked)
the project-level 'run in the script directory' switch (it is the root-cause fix, not a default)

recurrence: 6 zero_figures candidates in the weekly sweep (run 39758109474, main 602ccf61f, seed 202643): 3 via read_parquet, 3 via glob_dir that die in the script (the glob family is G5)
